description: The linuxserver/calibre-web repository carries several tag families besides the Calibre-Web releases this role tracks: bare build numbers (1 through 102), Calibre desktop versions (5.29.0 through 6.0.0-calibre), a calendar-versioned run from 2021 (2021.10.05 and friends), legacy v3.x-ls1 tags, and an -ls### suffixed tag for every linuxserver.io rebuild.
Renovate has already been caught by this once: pull request #5 proposed an upgrade to '5' and had to be autoclosed.

Restricting the datasource to the 0.x.y releases is what keeps calibre_web_version trackable. A future Calibre-Web 1.0.0 would be filtered out by this too, and this rule would have to be revisited then.
